reference.source: Rigid-body rotation has F=R, so C=I and an objective finite-strain elastic law produces zero incremental stress
reference.confirmed_from: finite-strain kinematics and rotation-test seed documentation

tolerance.metric: maximum rotation-stage stress normalized by elastic modulus
tolerance.rationale: Declared before solve; isolates the exact rigid-rotation invariant without relying on a hyperelastic material registration.

convergence.note: One-element rotation regression; time-stage trend is reported instead of formal mesh order.
